title: Reverse an Array
description:
Write a function that takes an array and reverses it in-place.
Example: [1, 2, 3] -> [3, 2, 1]
explanation: Use two-pointer technique: swap elements from start and end.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an integer array, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
explanation: Use Kadane's Algorithm: track max-ending-here and max-so-far.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
explanation: Use a Hash Map to store the difference (target - element) as you iterate.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
explanation: Use a Stack to push opening brackets and pop matching closing brackets.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return -1.
explanation: Use divide and conquer. Check mid element, if greater go left, if smaller go right.
